 Diesel price rises by Rs2.29 per litre, petrol rate unchanged 
 Web Desk 10:45 AM | October 31, 2026 Business Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on Facebook Share on Twitter The federal government has raised the price of high-speed diesel by Rs2.29 per litre, while keeping petrol rates unchanged for the period from October 31 to November 2.
 Under the revised rates, diesel will now cost Rs402.96 per litre, compared with its previous price, while petrol will continue to be sold at Rs377.91 per litre.
 The Petroleum Division issued a notification confirming that the new prices took effect on October 31 and will remain applicable until November 2.
 Separately, the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (OGRA) has begun uploading daily petroleum price calculations to its official website in a move aimed at improving transparency in fuel pricing.

 Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik said the calculations were based on a seven-day average of international oil market rates, following practices adopted in other countries.
 The revised mechanism is intended to help domestic fuel prices respond more promptly to movements in global petroleum markets.
